correctness.rationale: For [x,y,z]=det(x,y)z2 e1 and general N=[[a,b],[c,d]], expanding all terms in the specified two-order ternary Nijenhuis identity as polynomials in the independent coordinates x,y,z,a,b,c,d yields identically zero defect. I independently computed the complete six-coordinate symbolic tensor, rather than trusting saved VERIFY_OK. The induced bracket is exactly det(x,y)(c z1+d z2)(d e1-c e2). It vanishes precisely when the second row (c,d) is zero; otherwise w=(d,-c), choose v with cv1+dv2=1, then det(w,v)=1 and [w,v,v]_N=w, proving isomorphism. Thus q^4 N, q^2 zero deformations and q^4-q^2 nonzero, with standard 2x2 rank distribution (1,(q-1)(q+1)^2,q(q-1)^2(q+1)). Polynomial identity proves the theorem in all claimed characteristics; finite enumeration is supportive.

value.rationale: Correcting an explicit erroneous published classification on the minimal nonabelian Lie triple system has independent mathematical value. The structural finding is not merely q^4 from a trivial four-entry enumeration: the cubic torsion equation collapses identically for all N and induces exactly two isomorphism types, providing a useful base case for deformation theory.
